title: 30A Southern Sugar
meta_description: 30A Southern Sugar is a 7BR coastal retreat with a private pool, hot tub, game room, golf cart, bikes, and space for 26 just minutes from the beach.
description_expanded:
Welcome to 30A Southern Sugar, a spacious coastal retreat designed for sun-soaked days, easygoing nights, and unforgettable group getaways along Florida's iconic Scenic Highway 30A. Tucked into the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, this home places you just minutes from sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters---close enough for spontaneous beach runs, yet perfectly set up for relaxing days at home.

With 7 bedrooms and 7.5 bathrooms, this thoughtfully designed home comfortably sleeps up to 26 guests, offering plenty of space to gather, spread out, and settle into vacation mode. The open-concept interior creates a natural flow between the living room, dining area, and kitchen, making it easy to stay connected whether you're cooking, lounging, or catching up over a meal. The fully equipped kitchen is stocked with all the essentials, complemented by barstool seating at the island and a dining table ready for group dinners.

Down the hall and up the stairs, each bedroom is designed with comfort in mind, complete with its own ensuite bathroom and TV for added convenience. The primary suite stands out as a private retreat, featuring a spa-like ensuite bathroom with a spacious walk-in shower and a beautiful standalone soaking tub. Two upscale bunk rooms with full-size beds add flexibility, perfect for kids or groups of friends. The second-floor primary suite has an ensuite coffee bar for convenient, cozy mornings.

Step outside and you'll find your own private oasis. The backyard is made for long, sunny days---featuring a sparkling pool, hot tub, and a lush lawn for lounging or playing. Stretch out on the patio loungers, gather around the outdoor dining table for al fresco meals, or rinse off in the outdoor shower after a day at the beach. Upstairs, the upper deck and balcony offer additional outdoor seating, perfect for soaking in the coastal breeze and golden-hour skies.

When you're ready to explore, hop on one of the provided bikes or take the golf cart for a quick ride to the beach---typically just a short 3--5 minute drive or under a mile away. You're also within easy reach of 30A favorites like Gulf Place Town Center, local cafés, boutique shops, and scenic bike trails that wind along the coast.

Back at home, the fun continues in the game room, where foosball, arcade games, a TV, and its own kitchenette create the perfect hangout spot for all ages.

With thoughtful amenities like two spaces for in-home laundry on the first and second floors, easy parking, and plenty of room for everyone, 30A Southern Sugar is your home base for a laid-back, memory-filled stay on the Gulf Coast.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The pool can be heated for an additional fee of $150/night.
- Please note that the Golf cart and 4 bikes will become available upon receipt of a signed liability waiver.

Parking Details:
- 4 cars can be parked in the driveway.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
